item.title: Margarita Dzama-Karels wins Pagano Award
item.description: Congratulations to Postdoctoral Scholar Margarita Dzama-Karels, who was awarded a 2026 Joseph S. Pagano Award for her 2025 paper, Menin-MLL1 complex cooperates with NF-Y to promote hepatocellular carcinoma survival. This annual award recognizes notable cancer-related papers authored by UNC Lineberger postdoctoral fellows.
